GLE binomial logit with a factor: the data are separated, so the fit stops after 12 Newton steps with coefficients near 126/-13/-29/-45 and a Cholesky pivot near 7e-7; at that conditioning our solve and Modeler's differ by about 2e-7 relative (row 11 $LC-y_flag 0.999938955265657 vs ours 0.9999389537211862), which is rounding, not a different rule

GLE binomial identity link: Modeler stops at 4.9316 - 0.5164 x (mean 4.67 at row 1 for P(F)), which is not a root of the score equations, so its iteration ends early in the out-of-range region; not reproduced by IRLS without clipping (diverges), with NaN likelihoods skipping step-halving, with mean or variance clipping (1e-12..1e-2), or with step-halving exhaustion (J 5..20); see the coordinator notes in rea-work/gle-lab

GLE binomial log link: Modeler stops at exp(34.33 - 3.513 x) ($GC-y_flag 1.39e14 at row 1), not a root of the score equations; the same IRLS, clipping and step-halving variants as for the identity link do not reproduce it (closest 16.96 - 1.997 x)
